newsitem.title: UK: NWE oil products steady to weaker.
newsitem.headline: NWE oil products steady to weaker.

text.p: NWE oil products were steady to weaker on Friday, traders said.

Gasoline was weaker and noticeably quieter with one Eurograde barge heard sold at $218 fob AR, down $2 or so. Naphtha was also easier by $1 or so with little physical business. High sulphur fuel oil barges were broadly steady. Business for January was done at $98 fob ARA while early February barrels were traded at $102.
Gas oil cargo premiums were steady in busy inquiry. Barges were quiet on slack demand. Prices fell $5.25 with futures.
